records.text: Owens identified the woman who retrieved the backpack after the shooting as Chrissy Pacheco, a Turning Point USA logistics employee.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: It is, again, more remarkable luck. It looks like choreography almost. They're so lucky that it happened to be a longtime Turning Point USA employee, Chrissy Pacheco, who picks up that backpack. ... It's not a random student or a passerby or police officer, but a person that was in charge of logistics on that day, a member of the logistics team for Turning Point USA that helped to set up everything. ... That is the truth of the answer. She's there in time just to pick up the backpack as it falls out, and I can show, we can show that again if we want to just show that clip of the backpack falling out and then it's sort of getting scooped by Chrissy (Chrissy Pacheco). Here we go. Here comes the backpack. We've highlighted Chrissy (Chrissy Pacheco) there, so you can see first ... thing she does is she picks up that backpack. End of story. Just in case you guys thought it was a rando, it's not a rando, someone on the Turning Point USA team.
